skill.name: ci
skill.description: Diagnoses CI pipeline failures, identifies root causes, proposes fixes, updates tests or implementation, and verifies results without bypassing quality checks.
skill.summary: Analyze and repair CI failures while preserving test and quality controls.
skill.author: Chachamaru127

security_audit.summary: All 30 static findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, a relative import example, and entropy heuristics on readable documentation. A semantic review found unvalidated placeholders in Bash command templates, creating a command injection risk during substituted execution.

remediation.issue: Unvalidated values are inserted into shell command templates.
remediation.suggestion: Accept only numeric run IDs. Resolve test paths inside the repository, pass arguments as arrays, and require confirmation before executing repository scripts.

semantic_findings.title: Unvalidated Placeholders in Shell Commands
semantic_findings.description: Command templates interpolate `{{run_id}}` and `{{test-file}}` into Bash commands without validation or quoting. Malicious values could add options or shell metacharacters during execution.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The Bash examples place placeholders directly in command positions, and the declared tool set permits Bash execution.

content.user_title: Diagnose and Fix CI Pipeline Failures
content.value_statement: CI failures can hide the first actionable error among noisy logs. This skill classifies failures, proposes targeted repairs, and verifies tests without bypassing checks.
actual_capabilities: Reviews GitHub Actions and GitLab CI failure logs.
Classifies build, test, dependency, and environment errors.
Identifies likely root causes and affected files.
Proposes focused changes to tests or implementation.
Runs targeted and full test commands to verify repairs.
Uses recent git history to trace likely regression commits.
limitations: Requires accessible logs, repository files, and relevant CI context.
Does not configure new pipelines or perform routine local build setup.
Cannot guarantee a fix when failures depend on unavailable secrets or external services.
Shell commands and repository test scripts require appropriate permissions and review.

use_cases.title: Triage a Failed Pull Request
use_cases.description: Extract the first actionable error from a failed workflow and recommend the smallest verification step.

use_cases.title: Repair a Test Regression
use_cases.description: Compare the failing test with implementation requirements, then repair the incorrect side without weakening coverage.

use_cases.title: Trace a Pipeline Regression
use_cases.description: Use recent commits and changed files to identify the likely source of a new CI failure.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze a Failed Run
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this CI log: [paste log]. Identify the first root cause, affected step, and next verification command.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner analysis of one failed job

prompt_templates.title: Fix a Failing Test
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect [test file] and [implementation file] for this failure: [error]. Compare behavior with requirements, then propose a minimal fix.
prompt_templates.scenario: Focused repair after the cause is known

prompt_templates.title: Trace a Regression
prompt_templates.prompt: Review recent commits and changed files for CI run [run ID]. Identify the likely introducing commit, explain evidence, and recommend focused validation.

prompt_templates.title: Repair a Multi-Stage Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Diagnose failures across [jobs]. Separate primary from cascading errors, implement approved fixes, rerun targeted checks, then report residual risks and changed files.

output_examples.input: The TypeScript build fails before tests start with TS2322 in the API module.
output: Primary failure: Type mismatch in the API module.
Tests did not run because the build stopped first.
Next step: inspect the assigned type and validate the API response shape.

output_examples.input: A Vitest mock no longer matches a newly added response field.
output: Root cause: the mock data is stale relative to the implementation contract.
Recommended fix: update the mock with the required field while preserving existing assertions.
Verification: rerun the affected test, then run the full suite.

output_examples.input: Several jobs fail after one dependency installation error.
output: Primary failure: dependency resolution failed during installation.
Later job failures are cascading results, not independent causes.
Resolve the dependency conflict before investigating downstream test output.

best_practices: Start with the earliest primary error before investigating cascading failures.
Confirm whether implementation or test expectations conflict with documented requirements.
Run the smallest relevant check first, then verify the complete test suite.
anti_patterns: Do not skip tests or remove assertions to make CI appear successful.
Do not enable continue-on-error or weaken lint rules instead of fixing causes.
Do not change test expectations without confirming the intended behavior.

faq.question: Which CI systems can this skill analyze?
faq.answer: It includes guidance for GitHub Actions and GitLab CI, and can interpret common build and test logs.

faq.question: Can it modify failing tests?
faq.answer: Yes. It first determines whether the test or implementation conflicts with requirements and requests approval when needed.

faq.question: Does it bypass failing checks?
faq.answer: No. It explicitly prohibits skipped tests, removed assertions, continue-on-error settings, and weakened lint rules.

faq.question: Can it identify the commit that caused a failure?
faq.answer: It can inspect recent structured git history and changed files to identify likely regression commits.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the failed log, run identifier when available, relevant test files, implementation files, and expected behavior.

faq.question: Will it rerun the pipeline?
faq.answer: It can run local verification commands. Remote pipeline reruns depend on available tools, permissions, and explicit user direction.
